item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.29
item.description: Meeting and QA panels share the same padding and Finish controls. Quick Actions preserve drafts when shortcuts change and replace selected text in more editors. This release also improves recording recovery, note deletion, and settings sync.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.30
item.description:
Click Refine on a saved note to speak an edit. The button becomes a waveform. Click it again to finish, then review and save your changes. If you cancel a follow-up, usefulwaves keeps the proposal you were editing.
Editing a QA review summary now preserves its title.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.31
item.description:
Home notes use their capture date and time as the title. Everything you type or dictate stays in the body, including the first line.
Refine shows proposed edits at the bottom of the note. You can review and save them without moving the editor. Test Screenshot also works while a Refine draft is waiting.
This update starts a fresh workspace. Previous captures, recordings, settings, and saved credentials stay in their old locations. Run setup, download your dictation model, and re-enter any API keys. Sign in again and enable sync to share new notes between updated Macs. Sync and usage analytics start off.
